title: Tutankhamun's tomb stays hidden under rubble until Howard Carter finds it

tellings.quote: So his stayed preserved and and overlooked until I think 1923 when uh when Howard Carter discovered it.

plain: The tomb of the Egyptian boy king Tutankhamun is said to have stayed buried under rubble, "preserved and overlooked," until the archaeologist Howard Carter found it, in 1923 by the teller's own uncertain reckoning ("I think 1923"). The researcher Luke Caverns tells Michels this without naming a source. He offers it as proof that something major can lie hidden in Egypt for thousands of years, so other finds may still be waiting.
